item.title: Indian Gaming Association Meets with Arizona Tribal Leaders to Strengthen Unity and Confront Threats from Prediction Markets
item.description: Phoenix, Arizona —The Indian Gaming Association (IGA) met last week with the Tribal leaders of the Arizona Indian Gaming Association (AIGA) to renew a long-standing partnership and reinforce a shared commitment to protecting Tribal sovereignty. The gathering continues the outreach efforts established by the late Chairman Ernie Stevens, Jr., whose leadership shaped much of today’s national Tribal gaming landscape. IGA Chairman David ...
